<!-- pr-reviewer: 0f4175a2f7a483f4359aa52a992a538426e449bc -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

Docs-only (SKILL.md plus a decision file), so nothing was built. Read, not run: no Rust crate changes, so the gate has nothing to select.

**What looks good**
- The rows match what #2077 describes, they sit with `set_work_material`, and the "pending" wording is honest.
- The decision file is present and the clean-room and layering laws are not touched.

**Requested before merge**
1. Bump `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (main is 76, so 77). The PR changes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, a process file, and AGENTS.md "Process changes bump `PROCESS_VERSION`" makes a missing bump a requested change. The decision file (`docs/decisions/2076-set-stock-material-skill.md`) says the bump was deliberately omitted under a "single-writer" rule, but AGENTS.md has no such rule. Open PRs #2083, #2092 and #1738 also bump to 77; whichever merges second takes 78, as AGENTS.md describes. Correct the decision file to match.
2. Do not merge this ahead of #2077 (still open, `feat!`, merges at the next cut). Until then main's MCP server has no `set_stock_material` and does not accept `cutting_data` `"unknown"`, `stepdown` or `stepover`. Every fork syncs the skill on each session through `PROCESS_VERSION`, so the skill would document tools the fork's code does not have. A "pending" marker mitigates this but does not fix it. Either fold these rows into #2077, or keep this PR as a draft stacked behind #2077 and merge it right after, then drop the "pending" text and re-check the rows against main.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Overlaps with #1738, #1817, #2037 and #2083 on the same file are other rows, so they should merge cleanly.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
